message.content: 神舟八号（Shenzhou‑8）是中国神舟计划中的一次无人试验飞行，于2008年9月25日发射。该飞行的主要目的是测试神舟飞船与天宫一号空间站的对接系统，并验证飞船的姿态控制、推进、通信等关键技术。由于是一次无人试验，神舟八号上没有宇航员登机。其任务成功完成后，为后续载人飞行（如神舟九号、十号等）奠定了技术基础。
message.reasoning:
The user asks in Chinese: "神舟八号的宇航员是谁" meaning "Who were the astronauts on Shenzhou 8?" They want the names of the crew of Shenzhou 8. We need to answer. According to known facts: Shenzhou 8 was a Chinese spaceflight in 2008, part of the Shenzhou program. It was a test flight with a robotic spacecraft, no crew? Wait, Shenzhou 8 was a test flight of the Shenzhou spacecraft, but it had no crew. Actually Shenzhou 8 was an unmanned test flight of the Shenzhou spacecraft, launched on 25 September 2008. It was a test of the spacecraft's docking system with the Tiangong-1 space station. It had no crew. So the answer: There were no astronauts aboard Shenzhou 8; it was an unmanned test flight. But the user might want the names of the crew that were scheduled? But the official record: Shenzhou 8 had no crew. So answer accordingly.
